 How to watch All Whites’ game against India live and free
 posted in: All Whites , News , Streams and videos , Uncategorized 
 | 
 Thursday’s international between New Zealand’s All Whites and India will be streamed live and free. 
 The match kicks off at 7pm (NZT) at Auckland’s Go Media Stadium Mt Smart.
 The match will be broadcast live on TVNZ and DAZN. Follow the links below to watch coverage of the game.
